create_WSProtocol: create a WSProtocol instance to handle WebSocket connections with uvicorn config and server state
run_ASGI_websocket: run an ASGI application over a WebSocket connection using WSProtocol scope, receive, and send
handle_websocket_events: handle WebSocket events including connect, text message, binary message, close, and ping
send_websocket_messages: send WebSocket messages including accept, text, binary, close, and HTTP response to clients
receive_websocket_messages: receive WebSocket events from the client queue with automatic backpressure flow control
